title: [slider] make tooltips contenteditable
body: Something like this would be fun (@bobylito idea): ![untitled screencast 5](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/9878898/474f5390-5bc5-11e5-84f6-351f0f247d22.gif) In order to do so, [algolia/noUiSlider](https://github.com/algolia/noUiSlider) must first be enhanced to provide this new option: ```js tooltips: { format: function() {}, editable: true } ``` Then: * we would have to parse the formatted tooltip in search for the numeric value * isolate the numeric value inside a `` * allow clicking the tooltip (currently it's e.preventDefault). We need to isolate drags from clicks (mousedown/touch + move = drag, mousedown/touch + mouseup/touch = click) * listen for contenteditable changes, update the slider and refinement accordingly * automatically reformat tooltip value after 100ms with no keystroke Annnnd a lot of other possible issues to fix. But still a good idea to provide a good slider
